posts.en:
dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Right-side details panel that turns the Matt Pocock skills collection into a DSH quest board: wayfinder decision maps, per-issue triage / fix / discuss / execute actions, 9-item core-skill probe plus 20-skill radar, environment checks, and one-click handoff across sessions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-797239b9883e492e6f5b.html
